{{Top}}
{{Quote|You loathsome two-eyed toad!|Ree-Yees|<ref name="ttbt">{{StoryCite|story=Tongue-tied: Bubo's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>}}
'''Toads''' were amphibious animals. Variants of toads were found in different worlds, including the arboreal [[Fevvenor toad]]s of [[Veron Minor|Veron]],<ref name="PotG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> the [[grub toad]]s of [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]],<ref name="E12">[[Ewoks (1985) 12|''Ewoks'' (1985) 12]]</ref> the [[grate toad]]s of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the [[spiny-collared toad]]s of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].,<ref name="ydr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> as well as the slow, bio-luminiscent [[Bo-toad]] of [[U-Tendik]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="ahfgt">''[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale]]'', ''[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale (webstrip)]]''</ref> and the [[freckled toad]]s owned by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="luptwt">{{StoryCite|story=Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

[[Zarian]]s<ref name="tpoc">''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''</ref> and [[Frog-dog/Legends|Frog-dogs]] had been physically compared with toads.<ref name="ttbt" /> [[Evir Derricote]] was said to have a toad-like demeanor.<ref name="derricote">Either ''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]'' or ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''; confirmation pending.</ref>
